item.title: AA Edit | Return To Democracy To Bangla Will Be Tribute To Khaleda
item.description: Prime Minister for two full terms, Khaleda was the wife of the first of Bangladesh’s many military rulers in the nation’s numerous turbulent swings from democracy to rule by military chiefs in its 54-year existence as an independent nation since it broke away from Pakistan in 1971
